title: Azusawa Kohane — To Be Worthy〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we were able to find the vocab workbook you wanted.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too! So many words that I don't know keep coming up during our English lessons. Also, I've been looking for something portable since we'll be going to the US soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And thanks for helping me find this even though we just had practice, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay since there were a few study guides which I've been meaning to flip through. So, I'm glad that we got to come here together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, let's keep doing our best to become better at English!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't notice that they had a travel goods display set up over there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, look at that. They've got suitcases and all sorts of other stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have some time, An, so why don't we go check it out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going over to visit the US soon, right? I was thinking that I should buy anything that I think I'll need right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Good point. In that case, I'll do the same.
So, let's go!
Travel Goods Display

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, look at all the different things they have here...! Oh, I think these are for when you're on an airplane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, looks like it. Hey, they've even got neck pillows! Wanna try one on?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh, sure.
Let's see... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this does support my head and neck nicely...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but I feel like I won't need anything like this to fall asleep... Do you think we should buy these?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've heard that having one can help a lot for those really long flights.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, I might get one if they have one with a good design.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, check it out! They've even got some cute sleep masks. Look, this one's a sheep's face.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All the sleep masks over here seem to be a part of an animal-themed line.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They've got so many.
Let's see... Sheep, dogs, cats, rabbits, bears...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, they even have koalas?!
And they have different breeds of dogs... I feel like they went a little overboard...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like this dog would suit you well, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because it looks so cute and full of energy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, don't tempt me by saying things like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, how about Akito and Toya? Which animals would you pick for them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A panda for Aoyagi, and a cat for Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, good choices...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A cat is particularly good for whenever Akito's pretending to be all kind and polite!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! N-No, I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you meanie...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway... This looks like the travel pouch section.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this one looks useful. It has so many little pockets inside...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look at that. I could keep my passport and other valuables in here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad said that it's always nice to have something like this handy... So, I think I'll buy one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too.
This does feel like an essential...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, wanna buy matching pouches?
That'd definitely make things more exciting for me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I want us to have matching ones!
So, let's take these up front!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for today, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you for going over to the bookstore with me in the first place! I really appreciate you coming along!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I know we aren't going just yet, but I'm glad we got to buy these matching pouches. Now I really can't wait for our trip to the US!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me neither!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was still a little nervous about it when we'd only just decided to go...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But now, I can't wait to go abroad with the others.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's have as much fun as we can in America, An!
